blocks.text: For the genitive plural of год the word лет is used.
«For the genitive plural of the noun **год** the word **лет** is used: **один год**, **два года**, **пять лет**.»

DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 41. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.q: Мэри начала пользоваться омолаживающим кремом с 14 ___ (годы).
exercises.prompt: Mary started using anti-aging cream when she was 14.
exercises.why: **год → лет** (gen. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural годы. The stem changes too, so no single ending is given.

exercises.q: Пять ___ (годы) назад у меня было отслоение сетчатки.
exercises.prompt: I had retinal detachment five years ago.
exercises.why: **пять лет** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (год → лет, irregular).

exercises.q: Возраст учащихся находится в промежутке от 18 до 25 ___ (годы).
exercises.prompt: The students range in age from 18 to 25.
exercises.why: **год → лет** (gen. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural годы. The stem changes too, so no single ending is given.

exercises.q: Президент России Владимир Путин разводится с женой Людмилой после 30 ___ (годы) брака.
exercises.prompt: Russian President Vladimir Putin is splitting with his wife Lyudmila after 30 years of marriage.
exercises.why: **год → лет** (gen. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural годы. The stem changes too, so no single ending is given.
